verdict.rationale: Relay documents user-set spend limits on the debit and credit cards it issues, and up to 20 checking accounts that can split funds into purpose-based buckets. That gives per-card enforced limits, but there is no evidence of budgets defined at the department or program level and enforced automatically across that unit's spend. A Trustpilot summary notes 'problems with prescribed limits,' but that is too vague to dispute the capability. Missing for 10: department- or program-level budget objects, automatic enforcement of a budget across multiple cards or users, any link between card limits and per-account program budgets, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set department or program budgets with automatically enforced spend limits
